title: Reference implementation and test vectors published
summary: The repository contains a dependency-free reference implementation, 15 recognition vectors and 5 inference vectors, and a command-line verifier (node reference/verify.mjs).

title: Specification draft v0.1 prepared
summary: The first draft of the Sanad specification (data model, recognition function, transparency log, privacy and threats) has been written and is open for discussion. It has not been reviewed by a standards body, a lawyer or an external cryptographer.

title: Name and legal form decided
summary: The protocol is called Sanad. The Open Sanad Foundation is to be established in the United Arab Emirates; until it exists, Dr. Arash Kermani Kolankeh acts as interim steward.

title: Website published in draft
summary: sanadprotocol.org is online in English, with draft translations in German, Arabic and Persian. It uses no cookies, no analytics and no external requests.
